title: Shipping and Delivery Policy
content: Standard Shipping takes 3 to 5 business days for domestic delivery and is free on orders above $50. Express Shipping takes 1 to 2 business days for a flat rate of $12.99. International deliveries take 7 to 14 business days depending on customs clearance. Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST ship out the same business day.

title: Return and Refund Policy
content: Customers may return unopened or gently used merchandise within 30 days of delivery. Returns are free when choosing store credit, or subject to a $5.99 return shipping fee when refunding to the original payment method. Perishable items and personalized merchandise are non-refundable. Refunds are processed within 5 business days of inspection.

title: How to Track Your Order
content: To check your order progress, locate your order ID in your confirmation email (format: ORD-XXXX). You can ask our virtual support assistant to look up your order status or visit the online tracking portal. Statuses include: processing, shipped, delivered, and cancelled.

title: Frequently Asked Customer Support Questions
content: Support operating hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. For billing inquiries, warranty claims, or address adjustments prior to shipping, please contact support with your order ID. We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and store gift cards.
